ai_provenance.environment_statement: This audit used the OpenAI model Daybreak Blue at the ultra reasoning level.

attack_result: Public-key-only zero-signing-query fresh-message forgery against the final-v3 numerical signature and message/hash interface
attack_runtime_scope: Primary strict-interior attack core: 0.076994 ms median over 64 fresh keys; complete primary driver: 1.16 s wall time
attack_technique: Strict-interior K-floor fixed point: set z1=0, derive c from the all-zero verifier floor and chosen message, and select each bounded z2 coefficient from {0,-(K-1),K-1} to reconstruct that floor
attack_title: The Writing Was on the Floor: A Zero-Query Fresh-Message Forgery against GLYPH
conditions: Claim confined to the numerical (z1,z2,c) paper/source signature fields and specified message/hash interface; no author-standardized external signature wire format
family: Ring-LWE/GLP lattice signature with K-floor compression

history_evidence.exact_target_search_result: No previous public substantive attack against final-v3 GLYPH was located in searches performed through 2026-10-13; this is a bounded dated search result, not an absolute priority claim
history_evidence.related_glp12_result: Ducas-Durmus-Lepoint-Lyubashevsky, ePrint 2013/383: same-message strong-unforgeability malleability requiring an existing signature; not an attack on final-v3 GLYPH

independent_reproduction_scope: Fresh-context implementation derived from the pinned public paper and source without the private lead or primary experiment package
limitations: The claim is pinned to final-v3 GLYPH and author source commit 74b96d691391f687fe8f91e1d5cb3c251762d7cc.
The author artifacts define no portable external signature wire format.
The result is a fresh-message forgery, not secret-key recovery.
No drop-in repair has been validated.
repair_guidance: Redesign the compression/verification relation so an attacker cannot derive a challenge for a public target and realize that target with bounded responses; then repeat correctness, unforgeability, and full-parameter analysis. Parameter increases and zero-floor rejection are not validated repairs.
security_property: Existential unforgeability under chosen-message attack; fresh attacker-chosen message with zero signing queries
technique_attribution: Concrete application to final-v3 GLYPH K-floor verification
title_wordplay_ai_decision: OpenAI Codex generated and selected the title and intentionally chose ‘The Writing Was on the Floor’ as wordplay on GLYPH/writing and on the zero K-floor that makes the forgery work.
verification_basis: Technical, practical, adversarial-review, fresh-context independent-reproduction, final-history, and independent Publication Reviewer gates passed
